title.narrative: UNICEF’s advocacy and policy dialogue efforts, combined with targeted local engagement, contributed to advancing the youth agenda in the country and to the prioritization of adolescent and youth empowerment and resilience building as key approaches for national and local stakeholders. By embedding priorities into strategic discussions, UNICEF has catalyzed a commitment to sustainable, skills-based development for adolescents at both policy and community levels. These initiatives have emphasized the importance of equipping adolescents with 21st century skills, fostering their ability to navigate challenges, seize opportunities and contribute meaningfully to society. ;;
